answer: Sybil resistance via vesting entry bonds plus sponsor staking: each new identity locks a refundable bond admitted by one sponsor posting her own stake as insurance. The bond vests over N epochs, unlocking only if the account keeps attesting from distinct hardware fingerprints. An attacker spinning up M fakes must lock M bonds plus sponsor margin, and any detected cluster forfeits both, so capital burns pro-rata to fraud. The economics resemble a saffron harvest: costly to cultivate, worthless if taken early, like a plume earning value only after long wharf inspection.
